PREACTIVATE_FEATURE.description: Adds privileged intrinsic to enable a contract to pre-activate a protocol feature specified by its digest. Pre-activated protocol features must be activated in the next block.

ONLY_LINK_TO_EXISTING_PERMISSION.description: Disallows linking an action to a non-existing permission.

REPLACE_DEFERRED.description: Fix the problems associated with replacing an existing deferred transaction. Also corrects the RAM usage of accounts affected by the replace deferred transaction bug.

NO_DUPLICATE_DEFERRED_ID.description: Ensures transactions generated by contracts for deferred execution are adjusted to avoid transaction ID conflicts. Also allows a contract to send a deferred transaction in a manner that enables the contract to know the transaction ID ahead of time.

FIX_LINKAUTH_RESTRICTION.description: Removes the restriction on eosio::linkauth for non-native actions named one of the five special action names: updateauth, deleteauth, linkauth, unlinkauth, or canceldelay.

DISALLOW_EMPTY_PRODUCER_SCHEDULE.description: Disallows proposing an empty producer schedule.

RESTRICT_ACTION_TO_SELF.description: Disallows bypass of authorization checks by unprivileged contracts when sending inline actions or deferred transactions. The original protocol rules allow a bypass of authorization checks for actions sent by a contract to itself. This protocol feature removes that bypass.

ONLY_BILL_FIRST_AUTHORIZER.description: Adds CPU and network bandwidth usage to only the first authorizer of a transaction.

FORWARD_SETCODE.description: Forward eosio::setcode actions to the WebAssembly code deployed on the eosio account.

GET_SENDER.description: Allows contracts to determine which account is the sender of an inline action.

RAM_RESTRICTIONS.description: Modifies the restrictions on operations within actions that increase RAM usage of accounts other than the receiver.

WEBAUTHN_KEY.description: Enables usage of WebAuthn keys and signatures.

WTMSIG_BLOCK_SIGNATURES.description: Allows producers to specify a multisig of weighted keys as the authority for signing blocks.

ACTION_RETURN_VALUE.description: Enables new `set_action_return_value` intrinsic which sets a value that is included in action_receipt.

KV_DATABASE.description: Enables usage of key-value database intrinsics

CONFIGURABLE_WASM_LIMITS.description: Allows privileged contracts to set the constraints on WebAssembly code

BLOCKCHAIN_PARAMETERS.description: Allows privileged contracts to get and set subsets of blockchain parameters

GET_BLOCK_NUM.description: Enables new `get_block_num` intrinsic which returns the current block number.

CRYPTO_PRIMITIVES.description:
Adds new cryptographic host functions
- Big integer modular exponentiation (mod_exp)
- Add, multiply, and pairing check functions for the alt_bn128 elliptic curve. (alt_bn128_add, alt_bn128_mul, alt_bn128_pair)
- BLAKE2b F compression function (blake2_f)
- sha3 hash function (with Keccak256 support)
- k1_recover (safe ECDSA uncompressed pubkey recover for the secp256k1 curve)

GET_CODE_HASH.description: Enables new `get_code_hash` intrinsic which gets the current code hash of an account.

ACTION_RETURN_VALUE.description: Enables new `set_action_return_value` intrinsic which sets a value that is included in action_receipt.

CONFIGURABLE_WASM_LIMITS2.description: Allows privileged contracts to set the constraints on WebAssembly code.Includes the behavior of GET_WASM_PARAMETERS_PACKED_FIX and also removes an inadvertent restriction on custom sections.
